newsitem.title: MEXICO: Monterrey firms have big debts coming due - bank. [CORRECTED 00:40 GMT 09/01]
newsitem.headline: Monterrey firms have big debts coming due - bank. [CORRECTED 00:40 GMT 09/01]

text.p: Companies in the northern region, especially in the Monterrey area of Mexico (corrects to clarify region) have up to $500 million in Eurobonds and syndicated loans coming due in the next few months, an executive of Citibank said on Wednesday.

"We have several possible transactions in the next months, and we will be talking about $400 or $500 million in refinancing, in Eurobonds and syndicated credits," regional executive director Kurt Vogt told reporters.
He said that in the last five years Citibank has arranged financing for regional companies for more than $3 billion in Eurobonds and syndicated loans.
